summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the direct public-company universe around restaurant commissary, dough, specialty ingredient manufacturing, and foodservice distribution infrastructure. The strongest reference asset is Domino's because it internalizes fresh dough manufacturing and food distribution, showing why this node can matter for franchise economics. The discovery lane points to less-discussed public companies supplying national restaurant chains through specialty food manufacturing, custom sauces/breads, and restaurant-focused distribution. This node is about hidden restaurant infrastructure: centralized dough, beverage, and ingredient production; foodservice distribution; and chain-level supply-chain control. Reference anchors like Domino's and Yum Brands show how much value can sit in procurement, specs, and distribution rather than in the storefront. The underfollowed discovery lane here is B2B coffee, private-label beverage, and restaurant ingredient suppliers with low visibility and chain-level customer dependence. Layer 1B expands the public-stock universe around scaled restaurant commissary, ingredient manufacturing, beverage/coffee solutions, specialty distribution, and direct-store delivery. Domino's is included only as a reference template because its vertically integrated supply chain shows why dough manufacturing and ingredient distribution can be strategic infrastructure. The underfollowed lane favors smaller or mid-cap suppliers/distributors that sit one step away from visible restaurant brands: specialty foodservice distribution, outsourced coffee/beverage solutions, and dire
